def find_sequence(N, B):
    A = [0] * N
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            if i != j:
                A[j] = B[i][j] - A[i]
    return A

    for i in range(N):
        B[i][p] = B[p][i] = new_values[i]
    return B
